name: Apophis Will

acquire.equipPiece: One black serpent-scale arm guard on one forearm; violet-black smear streaks that dim nearby light.

integrate.transformation: Full armoured form Apep-humanoid: a flared cobra-hood collar, slit crimson eyes and fanged jaw, black scale plate armour on shoulders and back, scaled digitigrade greaved legs, a long segmented tail, clawed hands and a fang-scythe grown from the wrist.

equip.weapon: A curved black fang-scythe grown from the right wrist, dripping violet decay.
equip.armor: Black overlapping scale armour: flared cobra-hood collar plates, shoulder and back scale plates, scaled greaves, crimson-edged segmented tail guard.
equip.hair_eyes: Hair turns black and falls like a hood-cloth; slit crimson eyes with no white.
equip.aura: Violet-black aura that dims the light and sheds slow grey decay motes.

beastNote: Apophis (Apep), Serpent of Chaos and Darkness
lore: Apep, the endless serpent that swallows Ra's sun each dusk. Its will has a Vritra-like decay: light dims and life withers around its gaze.
pitch: Apophis (Apep) is the endless serpent of chaos that swallows Ra's sun-barque each dusk, and its will has a Vritra-like decay: light and life wither where it passes. Acquire keeps you human, gliding in violet-black smears with one equipped piece, a single serpent-scale arm guard, to hide at dusk and lash with coils. Integrate (Full armoured form) turns you into a cobra-hooded serpent-humanoid in black scale armour whose gaze stops minds and swallows the sun, and it drains mana at SS rates.
untrained: An untrained holder is swallowed by the dark: the borrowed night dims the holder's own sight, the gaze turns on the holder and strain climbs fastest when the light is brightest. CANON ADDENDUM 2: the will lies dormant in the holder's mana core until it is forcefully awakened (a flame sparked in the core); if the holder cannot suppress and balance it, the clashing energies wreck body and core and can kill (design: strain climbs fast, backlash damage, forced cancel at the cap); mastery means training both the holder's own core and the beast core, best taught by the beast itself. This will summons no beasts or hordes.

spirit.echo: A tall cobra-hooded serpent-humanoid in black scale armour: wide flared hood, slit crimson eyes, fanged jaw, scaled digitigrade legs, long black segmented tail, fang-scythe on the wrist, shadow-ragged edges.
spirit.look: A black orb with a slit-pupil crimson eye that never closes; a thin ring of eclipsed light circles it and the core drinks the glow around it.
